notes.title: The May Update!
notes.content:
The May Update includes a multitude of new things;


Bosses: Bus, Mole-Crow
Enemies: Bees, Bats, Large Slime
Stages: Grass stages and Cavern stages
Audio Sliders are in.
Minor Bug Fixes
